column3: Updates the staff records by outcome and stage: in qualifying, the qualified (`european_cup_add_qualified_record`) or knocked-out (`european_cup_add_knocked_out_record`) record weighted by round (`scale_by_round`); in the group stages, qualified (6) or failed to qualify (0xfe, `european_cup_add_failed_to_qualify_record`); in the knockout, winners (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_winners_record`), runners-up (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_runners_up_record`), qualified or knocked out; whoever leaves gets `club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = -1 (`leave_euro_competition`); returns 0. `EuropeanCup::update_staff_records_for_status(club, outcome, stage, _a, game, end)`, the Champions League's virtual +0x44. Returns 0. Comp = +4. - In qualifying (stage 0xff): outcome 0 or 1, the qualification by the fixture's round (`fixture::ROUND_NUMBER`): in round 0, with `.stage_label()` and the round code of the next round (round 1: `cup_round::ROUND_CODE` + `cup_round::SIZE`, +0x6f of the round table `.round_table()`) and the weight `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, 0, 2); in any other, 0x41c, 0 and `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, round, 2). Outcome 0xff or 2: the elimination (`european_cup_add_knocked_out_record`) with the fixture's `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX` and `fixture::ROUND_NAME` and the weight `scale_by_round`(1, 0x14, round, 2), and the club leaves (`club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = −1). - In phase 1 (stage < 8): 6, the qualification (0x44a, −1, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x449, 0x32) and the club leaves. - In phase 2 (8 to 11): 6, the qualification (0, 0x78, 0x32); 0xfe, the non-qualification (0x44a, 0x32) and the club leaves. - In the knockout (12): 1, the title (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_winners_record`, thiscall(records, club, game, end), ret 0xc) and the club leaves; 2, runner-up (`exe::staff_records_add_cup_runners_up_record`, likewise) and the club leaves; 0, the qualification (0, the round code of the round after the fixture's (`cup_round::ROUND_CODE` + `cup_round::SIZE` from the fixture's round entry) in the knockout stage's round table (`.stages()` + 0x30, `.round_table()`, `cup_round::SIZE` bytes), `scale_by_round`(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)); 0xff, the elimination (0, the fixture's `fixture::ROUND_NAME`, `scale_by_round`(0x4b, 0x64, round, 2)) and the club leaves.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::sign_contract(contract, job)` (no SEH), called by the transfer completion (`exe::transfer_manager_move_player_to_club`), by the accepted offer (`complete_accepted_contract_offer`) and by the staff screen: puts the person in the contract club, handles loans, and stores the contract with its value, payroll and club change. A person without a club (`.club_job()`) outside a loan (`.contract_type()` = 5): added to the contract club (`exe::database_add_staff_to_club` with today); on failure: 0. A new job outside a loan with no room at the current club (`exe::database_club_has_room_for_job`): the cancelled-offer news (`exe::contract_manager_post_offer_cancelled_no_space_news`) and 0. A human current club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1): the scouts' lists (`FN_SCOUT_MANAGER_SYNC_SCOUT_LISTS`) and `exe::training_manager_update_coach_assignments`. On a loan: a squad above 50, the cancelled-trial news (`exe::contract_manager_post_trial_cancelled_news`) and 0; otherwise `exe::virtual_staff_remove_virtual_players`, added with job 11, the end by the length (`exe::date_days_since` and `exe::date_add_days` from today), job 8 in the high nibble of `.squad_status()`, the start today and `exe::staff_set_squad_flags`. The end is at least 4 weeks after the start (`exe::date_add_weeks`); the end also goes to the person's `staff::DATE_EXPIRES_CLUB`. The place in the array (+0 pointer, `contract_manager_fields::CONTRACT_CAPACITY` capacity, `contract_manager_fields::CONTRACT_COUNT` count): the index from the 79-byte record; with a contract at the same club, the old terms of `contract::SQUAD_NUMBER`..`contract::SQUAD_STATUS` stay (`contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN` 0, `contract::TRANSFER_ARRANGED_FOR` −1) and, in the nation of `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL` for a non-EU player (`exe::database_is_staff_eu_national`), when the person joined the club (`staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`) more than 100 weeks ago (today − 100 weeks, `exe::date_sub_weeks`), the second nationality (`staff::SECOND_NATION`) becomes that nation's (with the 1st from `KEY_NATION_BRAZIL` or on a draw of 3); at another club, the type by the job, `contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN`/`contract::TRANSFER_ARRANGED_FOR`, `exe::staff_contract_reset_morale_state` and `contract::CLUB_APPEARANCES` zeroed. Without a record: the first free slot (+0 = −1) gets the contract (type by the job, `exe::staff_contract_reset_morale_state`), the record, the payroll (`exe::finance_update_wage_bill`) and 1; otherwise at the end (grows by 100, realloc `exe::crt_realloc` or malloc `exe::crt_malloc`; without memory, box 0x1637). Then: the value (`contract::WAGE`) in the person's `staff::WAGE`, the morale (+0x14, `exe::staff_adjust_morale`) in type 2 with a player sheet, the payroll (`exe::finance_update_wage_bill`), and with a new job the departure from the current club (`exe::database_remove_staff_from_club`) and the arrival at the contract club (`exe::database_add_staff_to_club`); on failure: the box (0x1672, 0x167a) and 0.

`contract_manager_offer_contract(person, club_arg, out, slot, factor, mode)` (SEH frame for the local STAFF_CONTRACT without a destructor; x87): the contract the club offers: the desired contract × factor, the minimum release fee, the cap, the end date by age, the total by age and the value capped; returns the terms or makes the offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer`). Without a club, the club of the person's contract (the 79-byte record in `G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE` → the 0x50-byte contract in `[[G_CONTRACT_MANAGER]]`, kept in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`); none: 0. A national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`), a person retiring or retired (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`, bits 0x30 of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the record), the club itself outside types 11..15 (`exe::database_is_player_job` of `.job_for_club()`) with the club's list at 2 or without staff (`club::MANAGER`) and manageable (`exe::club_can_be_managed`), a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) or a future transfer (`exe::transfer_manager_get_future_transfer`): 0. The desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract` into the local, with the status `exe::shortlist_manager_get_squad_status_for_club`; a 3 with a current reputation (`.current_reputation()` of the sheet) above 5250 becomes 2); a return equal to `rdata::F64_0`: 0. The wage (`contract::UNKNOWN`) and the value (`contract::WAGE`) × factor. With a signing-on fee (`contract::MINIMUM_FEE_RC`): the minimum release fee (`contract::RELEASE_FEE`) by the value of the slot's offer (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value`: in bands of 50 thousand, 1 million and 5 million) or 50 thousand without an offer (100 thousand below the 1st band); without a signing-on fee, with `contract::RELEGATION_RC` or `contract::NON_PROMOTION_RC`, 50 thousand. The cap: the club's maximum wage (`exe::finance_get_max_wage`, with the job from the high nibble of `contract::SQUAD_STATUS`) × (factor + 1) × 0.5 for status 11, otherwise the staff one (`exe::finance_get_max_staff_wage`). The current contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`). A player (`.player()`): the age in days (`exe::date_days_since`) × k minus the sheet's weight (type 0x14 (`.goalkeeper()`) fixed, otherwise `.stamina()`, `.natural_fitness()` and the person's `.professionalism()`): above `rdata::F64_34` (or a current contract with nibble 6) the end next year (value × `rdata::F64_1_1`; bonus × `rdata::F64_1_25`); above `rdata::F64_31`, in 2 years (bonus × `rdata::F64_1_3`); above `rdata::F64_29` with the club's reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) above the sheet's (`.world_reputation()`) × `rdata::F64_1_2`, the year by age (bonus × `rdata::F64_1_5`). A value above 10 thousand and an age above `rdata::F64_30`: the total (weeks to the end × value) against ability and age (pow `game_pow`): reduces the value for each 52 weeks fewer or lowers the cap to total / weeks. A current contract that ends later: 0; an injury (`FN_INJURY_GET_PLAYER_INJURY`) above 70 days (`injury_entry::DAYS_LEFT`) with `G_INJURY`: 0. With `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_IN_FORCE` = 1, at most 5 years. A value above the cap × `rdata::F64_1_4`: 0; above the cap: the wage and the bonuses × value / max(cap, 1) and the value = cap. The grievances cleared (`exe::staff_contract_clear_all_grievances`). With `out`: copies the contract and 1; otherwise, in mode 2, or with a current contract in mode 1 that ends after `G_CONTRACT_DATE_PLUS_365_DAYS` + 150 days (`exe::date_add_days`), the offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer`); 1.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::update_after_match(game, summary)`, called by the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`): after each match, contract bonuses, happiness by minutes played, morale by a draw and by the result, and the development and happiness of those left out. With the match's `.home_side_mark()` and `.away_side_mark()`, the winner by the score (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`; with `.home_goals_extra_time()` = −1, `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`) and a copy of the 50 squad slots (`club::SQUAD`) of each club. First, per side (club B of the partner `exe::club_get_linked_b_team` and the side skipped by reputation are left out), the 20 slots of the summary (`match_stats_record::HOME_LINEUP` + side × 0x625, `match_record_row::SIZE` bytes): outside national sides, the contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) pays the bonuses (match_bonuses_for_slot); the minutes (`.minute_off()` for starters, 90 without a value; 90 − `.minute_on()` for substitutes) change the happiness (`contract::HAPPINESS`, minutes × 10 / 90, held at 50 below 50) or, for national sides, the +9 of the 79-byte record; outside national sides and friendlies, the substitutes and the starters with little playing time draw (2 × draw(30)) against the minutes: the happiness drops 4, `contract::UNHAPPY_FLAG` counts and the morale drops (`exe::contract_manager_lower_match_morale`); otherwise `contract::MATCHES_LEFT_OUT` counts (with 5 or more, outside the human club, squad mark 1 in `exe::staff_set_squad_flags`) and the morale rises (`exe::contract_manager_raise_match_morale`). The winner (and the loser) draws (21 − `staff::AMBITION`) below 4 for +3 (−3) on morale `contract::MORALE`; the person leaves the squad copy. Then, those left in the copy (with a player sheet, a contract, without suspension `exe::discipline_is_player_banned`, injury `exe::injury_get_player_injury_status`, national duty `exe::nationalteams_get_international_duty_club` or loan) develop (`exe::update_player_reputation_after_match` with the average rating of `G_PLAYER_STATS`, `player_stats_fields::RATING_SUM` / `player_stats_fields::RATED_COUNT` or `rdata::F64_6_8` with no rating, − 0.05 `rdata::F64_0_05`), `contract::UNHAPPY_FLAG` counts and, from 8 (14 with a partner), outside the human club and the partner, they leave the first team (`exe::contract_manager_get_squad_placement` 2 or 4 → `exe::contract_manager_toggle_squad_placement`); the happiness drops 8 and the morale drops.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::post_wants_new_contract_news(contract)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the daily staff pass (0x5ce2d0): posts news item 0xbc2, that the player wants a new contract, to the club manager, unless he is queued for a free transfer or in an offer. Without a contract: the "Error" box (line 0x2d91). A person queued for a free transfer (`exe::transfer_manager_is_queued_for_free_transfer`), with offers (`exe::transfer_manager_get_offers_for_player`) or offered in exchange (`exe::transfer_manager_get_exchange_offers_for_player`): nothing. Otherwise news item 0xbc2 to the manager of the contract club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): the club, the person, the squad status (`.squad_status()` >> 4), 0, the contract end (`.contract_expires()` signed day, `.contract_expires_year()` year), the wage (`.wage()`) and, in slot 11, 1 if the loyalty (`.loyalty()`) is below 10, `.professionalism()` below 5 and the sheet's reputation (`.world_reputation()`) above 4750.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::handle_transfer_request(contract)` (SEH frame for the local news item): handles a player's transfer request. A null contract: the "Error" box 0x2999. A person without a player sheet (`.player()`): nothing. A human club (`exe::news_club_has_human_manager`): the request news item (0xbbf), built on the stack (by the original). At a computer club, outside squad status 1 (`.squad_status()` & 0xf0 = 0x10): if the value (`exe::contract_manager_calc_player_value`) × 1.5 beats the asking price (`exe::contract_manager_calc_asking_price`), the club lists him (`contract::TRANSFER_STATUS`: clears bit 2 and sets 8; morale +12 in `exe::staff_adjust_morale`; the club lists `exe::shortlist_manager_add_player_to_club_shortlists`; `exe::contract_manager_post_transfer_listed_news`). Otherwise a draw by the contract's morale (`contract::MORALE`) and the loyalty (`.loyalty()`) against another of 50 gives the 0x10000 grievance (`exe::staff_contract_apply_event_flags`); the person's morale drops 12 (`exe::staff_adjust_morale`) and `contract::MORALE` grows by loyalty × 5 + 56, held at ±100.

`CONTRACT_MANAGER::resubmit_held_offers(id)`: resubmits the person's held offers as live offers, removes each one from the list and returns how many. It walks the held offers list (`contract_manager_fields::HELD_OFFERS`) and, for each one of person `id` (+0): with the transfer (`contract_offer::TRANSFER_OFFER_SLOT`, `exe::transfer_manager_get_offer_slot` over `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER`) whose serial (`.serial()`) is the one the offer kept (`contract_offer::TRANSFER_OFFER_SERIAL`), it sets state 0xf (`offer_status::COLLAPSED`) to 8 (`offer_status::AWAITING_PLAYER_DECISION`) and resubmits the offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer` with the slot, the serial, byte `contract_offer::MARK`, 1, 1, 0); without a transfer (`contract_offer::TRANSFER_OFFER_SLOT` = −1) it resubmits with −1, −1. It removes the offer from the list (`exe::llist_remove`) and counts it. Byte `contract_offer::MARK` is pushed in the whole register (the upper bits of whatever was in it: the pointer read or −1). Returns how many.

Records a result between two national sides: by competition, marks the general record, swaps the nationality or, in real internationals, counts each nation's match, scores the FIFA ranking and adds caps and goals to everyone who played; clears the type's +0x44 on its date and sends the news to the clubs. Ret 8: `NationalTeams::record_international_result(p, m)`: only between two national sides (`exe::database_is_national_team`). By the fixture's competition (`.competition()`): that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_B_INTERNATIONAL` marks `staff_state::B_INTERNATIONAL_PLAYED` = 1 in the general record of those who played; that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UNDER_21_INTERNATIONAL` sets `extra_flags::PLAYED_U21_INTERNATIONAL` (bit 2) of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` and swaps the nation (+0x1a/+0x1e, `swap_to_club_nation`); that of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_OLYMPIC_GAMES` nothing; the others: the FIFA ranking (`exe::fifa_rankings_record_match_result` on `national_teams_fields::FIFA_RANKING`) and, for those who played, the first call-up (`exe::staff_records_add_first_cap_record` with the opponent, if `staff::INT_APPS` = 0, after the nation swap), a cap (`staff::INT_APPS`) and the goals (`staff::INT_GOALS` += `.goals()` of the slot) for the national side and the match in the record (`exe::transfer_manager_record_international_appearance` with the nation's number of matches); only in this branch, each side's nation match count (+2 of the nation record) goes up, before its players. Then, per side: the type (1 if `.home_side_mark()` = 0; otherwise 2 for the second team `exe::club_is_national_team`, otherwise 0); on the type's date (`national_squad_record::SQUAD_DATE` + 20 × type, `exe::date_operator_3d_3d` with today's) zeroes +0x44 + 20 × type; the news to the clubs (`exe::nationalteams_send_club_international_report_news`) with the star player (slot `match_record::HOME_CAPTAIN`) and the list of those who played. No SEH, no box, no random draw.

Returns the age limits (23/23 in the main international finals, 24/22, 26/22). Stdcall, ret 0x10: the age limits (`*minimum`, `*maxima`) of a national side in competition `comp`: 23/23 in the main finals (`.competition()` with the id of one of the 9 keys `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FIFA_WORLD_CUP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_OLYMPIC_GAMES`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_EUROPEAN_FOOTBALL_CHAMPIONSHIP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_COPA_AMERICA`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_AFRICAN_CUP_OF_NATIONS`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_ASIAN_CUP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_OCEANIA_NATIONS_CUP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FOOTBALL_TOURNAMENT_OF_THE_ASIAN_GAMES`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_CONFEDERATIONS_CUP`); 24/22 with `kind` 1 or above 2; otherwise 26/22. Null pointers: the original routine (error box).

In the nations of the continent (`.continent()`), the current and next competitions taken as finished (`is_comp_finished`: without `end_of_stage`, `competition::CONTINENT` null; with it, `competition::CONTINENT` equal to the Europe continent record, `KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE` in `G_CONTINENT_TABLE`) become −1; with the current one empty and a next one, the next moves up, with the notice (`notify_manager_manager`).

Like the First one (6th, 3rd, 5th and 4th, through `create_playoff_stage`), but the new stage's +0x3a (the 10th argument of the Cup_Stage constructor `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, not a field of `this`) is the extra returned by virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` instead of 0xa0 (error box lines 0x2b6 and 0x2cc).

`Club_Records::update_transfer_fee_records(transfer)`: updates the buyer's paid record and the seller's received record, for the season and all time (fee, reference, other club, date, loan). \n The person (`target_staff_id()`) and the buying club (`buyer_club_id()`); the person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract` over [`G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`], kept in [`G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`]) gives the seller (`club()`). The buyer's season (`exe::club_records_get_season_record`) and all-time (`exe::club_records_get_all_time_record`) records are fetched (created when missing); without a seller, returns 1. A fee (`fee()`) above the season paid record (`club_record::FEE_PAID`) becomes the record: the fee, the person's reference (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`, at `FEE_PAID_HOLDER`), the seller (`FEE_PAID_OTHER_CLUB_ID`), today's date (`FEE_PAID_DATE`) and the loan flag (`FEE_PAID_FLAG`: `exchange_players()` ≠ 0); if it is above the all-time record it is copied there, and if it passes 1000 × (reputation + 300) (`is_big_transfer`): the record goes to the news queue (`exe::club_records_queue_record_news`, 0x1c, if it is not there yet) and the chairman (`chairman()`, `club::CHAIRMAN`) comes to favour the person (`exe::staff_add_favoured_staff`, forced). The same for the seller in the received record (`club_record::FEE_RECEIVED`; the queue with 0x1d, without the favouring). Returns 1.

`database_player_initialisation(data)`: prepares every person of the new game. Called once at creation (create_game `exe::create_game`), with the "Player Initialisation" bar (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`, `exe::screenmanager_send_network_status_message` at every 1% of the people). 
 For each person: common name (`staff::COMMON_NAME` = −2: the row stored in [`G_EMPTY_COMMON_NAME_INDEX`], the first empty one or a random one), first and second name (−2: `exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`), the dates (`staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB` joined club, +0x46, +0x31), the 8 person attributes (+0x56..`staff::TEMPERAMENT`, outside 1..20: drawn at random), the adjustment by the nation's region (`nation::ACTUAL_REGION`), the missing nation (national team, club or drawn). 
 For the player (`staff::PLAYER`): the reputations (current `player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`, home `player_sheet::HOME_REPUTATION`, world `player_sheet::WORLD_REPUTATION`, in that order, on a 1..200 scale: each missing one from those that exist, otherwise from the ability or the club and nation reputations; home = current at a club of his own nation or without a club; stored × 50 at the end), the potential (`player_sheet::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`: −2/−1/0 rarely, by draws of 2000/750/100) and the current one (`player_sheet::CURRENT_ABILITY`), the age (birth drawn when outside 14..50), the positions and sides in the vector (`exe::database_player_to_attribute_vector`), and the attributes outside 1..20 from a template: the most similar player among 250 drawn at random (global vectors `G_PLAYER_INIT_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_A`/`G_PLAYER_INIT_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_B`, flag 0x9b59b8) or, without a template, by ability. 
 For the non-player (`staff::NON_PLAYER`): the reputations (×50, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION`/`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`/`non_player::HOME_REPUTATION`), `non_player::CURRENT_ABILITY`/`non_player::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`, `non_player::DIRECTNESS`, the template among 250 (`G_NON_PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR`/0xae2238, 0x9b59b9), the job (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB` 8/9/10), the famous names (`exe::staff_name_equals`: `non_player::FORMATION`) and the missing job. At the end of each person, the age (`staff::AGE`). 
 Then the second pass: the ability-relative vectors (×10 − ability, ±200, /2) and the normalisations (`exe::staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_player_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_non_player_attributes`). 
 The stack vectors (0x54, 0x290) are only cleared on entry: what one person leaves carries over to the next, as in the original; the best score ([esp+0x40], −31073 on entry) too. No people: the error box and the end, through the original. The local at [esp+0x114] (1, zeroed with a club of reputation 0) is never read.

The reputation of `person` as seen by `who_ve`, by the scope (`exe::database_get_reputation_scope`): from the player data (`player()`: home `player_sheet::HOME_REPUTATION` +9, current `player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION` +0xb, world `player_sheet::WORLD_REPUTATION` +0xd) or, with `not_player`, from the non-player data (`non_player()`: `non_player::HOME_REPUTATION` +8, `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` +0xa, `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` +0xc). \n 4 → world, 2 → home, 0 → current, 3 → half the world + half the home, other → half the current + half the home (truncating divisions). Only ax is returned.

`database_trim_club_table(size)`: trims the club table by the database size. Called once at creation (create_game). Small = size 1 or 2. 
 Per nation (calloc `exe::crt_calloc` of 0xd0 bytes per nation: 50 ids, count `nation_club_bucket::CLUB_COUNT`, index of the lowest `nation_club_bucket::WEAKEST_SLOT`), the clubs with the highest reputation (`reputation()`, signed 16 bits): up to 20 (15 in the small one); a nation not chosen (`nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED`) and outside the 15 nation keys: up to 5 (size 2) or 11 (size 1). Also kept: the clubs of people (+0x39, +0x24), those of the competition histories (+0xa, +0xe, +0x12, in range) and, outside the small one, those of the history of people with a chosen nation; the national teams; the club keys (`exe::remap_club_key_id` receives each id with the new row and returns 1 if it is a key); and those of chosen nations, except (in the small one) the weak ones of `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND`. 
 Swaps the club pointers (club +0xb3/+0xb7/+0xbb, person +0x39/+0x24, preferences +4..+0x18, people history +0xa, competition history +0xa..+0x16) for the new ones (null for those removed), builds [`G_CLUB_ENGLISH_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`] (new row → old id, malloc), compacts the table (id = new row), reallocs in place (another address: box 0x4ca and the end) and writes "Club table has %d entries" to 0xde1f64. 
 Without [`G_NATION_TABLE`]: the original (box at line 0x4f6). Out of memory on new: returns at once, as the original does (no box). Out of memory on the callocs: box and the end, as the original.

`database_staff_matches_names(person, first, surname, common, date)`: 1 if the person, who must have a player record (`player()`) or a non-player record (`non_player()`), matches: each non-null name (`staff::FIRST_NAME`, `staff::SECOND_NAME`, `staff::COMMON_NAME`) has the requested id (`names::ID`) and, with `data`, the birth date (`date_of_birth()` day, `date_of_birth_year()` year) is the same (the day and year words compared directly; the original calls `Date::operator==`, `exe::date_operator_3d_3d`); otherwise 0. \n Null person: the original (error box and 0). Used by screens, regeneration and transfers (~137 callers).

Returns the player's condition: form × condition / 10,000 (minimum 100, maximum 9000 while recovering), or as a percentage (maximum 100). \n `Injury::get_condition(player, in_percent)`: the player's condition: `condition()` (`physical_record::CONDITION`) × the form (`physical_record::FORM`, +8) / 10,000 from the id's 31-byte record [this], at least 100 and at most 9000 while he is recovering (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 1); as a percentage (× `rdata::F32_0_009999999776` + `rdata::F64_0_5`, _ftol), at most 100. A person outside the players (`G_STAFF_COUNT`): 100 or 10,000. Null player: 0.

Allocates every person's 31-byte injury record fully fit; players may get a recurring injury (1 in 10) or start injured (1 in 100); the totals go to 0xde1f64. \n `Injury::init_records()`: [this] = 31 bytes per person of `G_STAFF_COUNT` (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the "Error" box for line 0x7d0 and nothing). Each record: today's date (`exe::date_operator_3d`), form and condition 10000 (`physical_record::FORM`, `physical_record::CONDITION`), wear 0 (`physical_record::FATIGUE`), no injury (`physical_record::CURRENT_INJURY` −1), no recurring injury (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` 0xff), history −1 (`physical_record::HISTORY_FIRST`, `physical_record::HISTORY_LAST`), `physical_record::LAST_INJURY_TYPE` 0xff, `physical_record::PRONENESS` 50. A player (`staff::PLAYER`): the type drawn from 82 with weight (+8 of the 13-byte table at 0x9e7ad8) and 1 in 10 becomes recurring; 1 in 100 starts injured: category drawn from 12, type through `exe::injury_choose_injury_type` (severity −1) and the new injury `exe::injury_add_injury`. At the end the two totals in 0xde1f64 ("%d players with ...").

Resets a person's injury state: removes their items from the match knock list, ends the injury, rewinds the history and restarts the 31-byte record; bit 0 of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record is cleared. \n `Injury::reset_player(id)`: removes from list `injury_fields::MATCH_HIT_LIST` (from the start: `set_cursor(head())`) each item with the id (`exe::llist_remove`); with an injury (`current_injury()` ≠ −1), ends it (`exe::injury_end_player_injury`, no news); restarts the history (`exe::injury_reset_player_history`); the 31-byte record restarts: today's date (`exe::date_operator_3d` of `G_CURRENT_DATE`), form and condition 10000 (`physical_record::FORM` +8, `set_condition`), wear 0 (`set_fatigue`), no injury (`set_current_injury(-1)`), no recurring injury (`set_recurring_type(0xff)`), history −1 (`set_history_first`, `set_history_last`), `set_last_injury_type(0xff)`. Bit 0 of `staff_state::EXTRA_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) is cleared. Returns the address of that byte.

Rebuilds a retired person from the regen queue as a young player: player record, nation, names, languages, age and ability, reputations, birth date, physical and mental attributes and, by chance, a club. \n `PLAYER_REGEN::regenerate_as_youth_player(p)`, from the regen queue (`process_regen_queue`) for every young regen. A person not retired (bits 0x30 of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record) or with a club (`club_job()`): it only clears the bits. Otherwise: leaves the national team (`national_teams_remove_player`), takes the front record of the player record pool (`player_regen_fields::PLAYER_DATA_POOL`, 16-byte entries: record, nation `regen_pool_item::NATION_ID`, second nation `regen_pool_item::SECOND_NATION_ID`; `exe::player_regen_remove_player_data_from_pool`), becomes a player (`set_classification(2)`, `set_player` the record) and the 79-byte record gets the regen mark (`staff_state_status_flags::REGEN_MARK`) and loses the others; the person's lists and histories are cleared (fog, statistics, history, suspensions, injuries, dispute, discipline, fitness, contracts); the record's nation (or, if its `nation::NUMBER_STAFF` is below 100, with 1/4, any one with `number_staff()` below 100), the second nation (Spain `KEY_NATION_SPAIN` with 1/100 keeps the previous one; another one other than the Basque Country `KEY_NATION_PAYS_BASQUE` with 2/3 none), the nation's names (`exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_get_empty_common_name`), the languages (all removed, `exe::playerstats_remove_language`; the nation's by weight, `exe::player_stats_get_native_language_points`, level (weight − (20 − `adaptability()`) × 10) / 75 up to 10, `exe::playerstats_add_language`), the joining date today, `job_for_club()`/`job_for_nation()` = 11 (`job_kind::PLAYER`). The age and ability: a small nation (`number_staff()` below 350, `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED` zero) by the `number_staff()` (23..27 or 17..23 years) and by the PA; otherwise by the record's position and the age by random(10000) (15..18 rare, 16..18, 17..20, 21..26). The reputations (`home_reputation()`, `current_reputation()`, `world_reputation()`), the ability caps, the birth year and day, the age (`exe::database_get_staff_age`), the physical and mental attributes (`player_sheet::ACCELERATION`, `player_sheet::PLAYER_PACE`, `player_sheet::AGILITY`, `player_sheet::JUMPING`, `player_sheet::NATURAL_FITNESS`, `player_sheet::WORK_RATE`, `player_sheet::STAMINA`, `player_sheet::STRENGTH`, `player_sheet::ANTICIPATION`, `player_sheet::DECISIONS`, `player_sheet::IMPORTANT_MATCHES`, `player_sheet::LEADERSHIP`, `player_sheet::CONSISTENCY`) by age; under 19 and a nation with `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED`, with 3/4, the best club (`exe::player_regen_pick_best_club_for_player`) and the contract (`FN_PLAYER_REGEN_SIGN_FOR_CLUB`, news `exe::player_regen_post_youth_promotion_news` at a human club; with a potential (`player_sheet::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`) above 80, the chairman (`club::CHAIRMAN`) favours him when draw(100) is below his `interference()`, `exe::staff_add_favoured_staff`); otherwise, by chance, a club of the nation (`exe::player_regen_pick_club_from_nation_list`). Without a club and under 20, the reputations up to 1250 and `world_reputation()` = 1. At the end, the attributes normalised (`exe::staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`, `exe::staff_normalise_player_attributes`).

Posts news item 0xbba about the retirement to the managers (all, the country, the division, the club or the interested clubs, by fame) and pays the club insurance when injury retires a valuable player. \n `player_regen_post_retirement_news(p, reason, announced)` (stdcall, ret 0xc; `process_retirements` puts this in ecx, unused; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path). No person, a player with job 8 or 5 (`job_for_club()`), no club, or a club without a human manager (`FN_NEWS_CLUB_HAS_HUMAN_MANAGER`): nothing. News 0xbba (local): 0..3 the person (id and the `names::ID` of `staff::FIRST_NAME`/`staff::SECOND_NAME`/`staff::COMMON_NAME`), 4 the reason, 5 announced, 6 the club (−1 if none), 7 the nation (`nation()`) if he has national caps (`int_apps()` ≠ 0), otherwise −1, 8 the job (0xf becomes 8, 0xd becomes 6), 9 the national caps (`int_apps()`), 0xa `job_for_nation()`, 0xb player record and non-player record, 0xc the age, 0xd the non-player record, 0xe the player record. The interested clubs (`exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` on `G_TRANSFER_MANAGER` with 0xa, up to 30, only for a player). A major nation (`league_standard()` above 8) and a star (`world_reputation()` of the player record above 8500, or a manager of job 5 with non-player `world_reputation()` above 8750): to everyone (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); a lesser star (`world_reputation()` above 7500, or job 5 with non-player `current_reputation()` above 7250): to the managers of the nation and of the club's nation (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`); a manager of job 5 at a club with a division: to those of the division (`exe::news_send_to_division_managers`); a non-player: to the club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); a player: to the interested clubs. Reason 8 (injury) with `current_reputation()` of the player record above 4250 and a contract club (`contract_of_uncached`, cached in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`): the insurance (`exe::news_post_insurance_payout` with `value()`).

At a new game, decides whether a person with a club retires this season: non-players by the job age limit, players by the profile limit, the ability, the club's competition and the contract status; fills the output and the dates. \n `player_regen_check_initial_retirement(person, out)` (thiscall without reading this, ret 8): on a new game (from `build_initial_retirement_list`), does the person with a club (`club_job()`) retire this season? The contract (contract_with_current_club) and the status (contract_status). Without a player record (`player()`): without a manager record (`non_player()`) always; with it, when past the limit (non_player_age_limit); reason 0x20. A player: past the record's limit (player_age_limit), v = ⌊⌊1 − (age − limit) × 0.1 (`rdata::F64_0_1`)⌋ × current reputation (`current_reputation()`)⌋ (16 bits); over 45, reason 1. A club without a competition (`division()`; without a club, a nation without `league_selected()`): random(3) ≠ 0 retires, otherwise only a negative status with a club. Otherwise: v ≥ 5000 or `current_ability()` > 80, no; `current_ability()` < 10 or v < 1500, yes; with a club, only a negative status; without a club, reason 2 with random(25 × `stamina()`) = 0. Whoever retires: the output (fill_retirement_entry: id, club, reason) and the announcement and retirement dates (set_retirement_dates, by the key nation; without a valid key nation, tomorrow); returns 1.

In the search for new retirements, decides whether the person retires: like the initial check, with the limit adjusted by contract and wage, unemployment, contract end and potential; without a key nation, dates drawn near today. \n `player_regen_check_retirement(person, out)` (thiscall without reading this, ret 8), from the search for new retirements (`find_new_retirements`). Without a player record: as in `player_regen_check_initial_retirement` (reason 0x20). A player above the record's limit: over 33, the limit drops 1 without a contract with the club, or with `grievances()` in the contract and `attacker()`/`attacking_midfielder()` of the record = 20, or the high nibble of `squad_status()` = 7; with a club and a contract with wage (`wage()`) above 750 × (`loyalty()` + 10) until after this year (`contract_expires_year()`), it drops 1 (and 1 more with `loyalty()` < 6). v = ⌊(1 − (age − limit) × 0.075 (`rdata::F64_0_075`)) × current reputation (`current_reputation()`)⌋ (16 bits). Reason 1: over 45; over 34 without a club and unemployed for more than 65 days (since `date_joined_club()`, `FN_DATE_DAYS_SINCE`); 3 years above the limit, over 31 and the contract's `unhappy_flag()` > 5; 4 above: without a club; or a contract less than 300 days from its end (`exe::staff_contract_days_to_end_date`), status below 50 and manager (`non_player()`) or `ambition()` > random(20) with potential × 0.85 (`rdata::F64_0_85`) above the current ability (`potential_ability()` and `current_ability()`). Then v > 5500, no. A club in a competition not running in the game (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`[id] = 0, or without `division()`; without a club, a nation without `league_selected()`): random(3) = 0 retires; with a club and a negative status too; otherwise only with v < 3500. Otherwise as in `player_regen_check_initial_retirement` (`current_ability()` > 100 no; `current_ability()` < 10 or v < 1500 yes; with a club only a negative status; without a club reason 2 with random(25 × `stamina()`) = 0). Whoever retires: the output and the dates (without a valid key nation, set_dates_no_key_nation, near today); returns 1.

Decides whether an unemployed person retires: a weak manager without a club, a player unemployed for over a year, or anyone with no record; fills the entry (reason 0x10, the game date) and returns 1. \n `player_regen_check_unemployed_retirement(person, out)` (stdcall, ret 8): whoever is on the shortlist (`player_regen_is_on_shortlist`) does not retire. With a manager record (`non_player()`): without a club (`club_job()`) and without `national_job()`, with `current_reputation()` of the record below 50 and random(5) = 0. Without it, with a player record (`player()`): off the list (checked again), without a club and without `national_job()`, unemployed for more than 365 days (365 × (year − year of `date_joined_club_year()`) − day of `date_joined_club()` + day) and random(the player's current reputation, `player_sheet::CURRENT_REPUTATION`) < 750. With neither record: always. Retires: the output (26 bytes) receives the person, reason 0x10 (`set_reason`), `set_announced(0)`, the club (`set_club_id`, −1 if none) and the game date at +8 and +0x10; returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Scores a person as the donor of non-player data: −10000 with a non-player record, when retiring or retired, or under 31; otherwise random draws and attribute terms. \n `player_regen_score_non_player_candidate(person)` (stdcall, ret 4): the person's score as donor of the non-player data (from `player_regen_pick_staff_for_non_player_data`, for each non-player person). −10000 with `non_player()`, with bits 0x30 (`staff_state_status_flags::RETIREMENT_STATE`) of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`) or under 31 (`age()`). Otherwise random 150 × (age − 31); with a club (`club_job()`) with reputation (`reputation()`) and a player record (`player()`), + 250 × (the player's current reputation `current_reputation()` ÷ the club's reputation); with a player record, + random(⌊(`leadership()` ÷ 2)³⌋) (pow `game_pow` and _ftol), +100 with `world_reputation()` > 7500 and +50 with `current_reputation()` > 7500; the attributes + 5 × (3 × (`temperament()` + `pressure()`) + 2 × (`loyalty()` + `determination()`) + `adaptability()`) + ⌊`professionalism()`²⌋ + ⌊`ambition()`²⌋. With a club: a random draw of the score (+75 if the club has no `manager()`); without a club: + (`int_apps()`)², and the score doubles if the player's `world_reputation()` exceeds a random(10000) (it reads the player record without checking, as the original does). Hot (every person on each call): no counter.

Posts news item 0xbce about a youth player joining the club, with the assistant manager's or a coach's verdict on his ability. \n `player_regen_post_youth_promotion_news(j, c)` (stdcall, ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path), from the young regen (`regenerate_as_youth_player`). No player or club: nothing. News 0xbce (local): 0..3 the player (id and the `names::ID` of `staff::FIRST_NAME`/`staff::SECOND_NAME`/`staff::COMMON_NAME`), 4 the club id, 5 the age, 6 the club's training facilities (`training()`) above 15. The assistant manager (`assistant_manager()`) and the five coaches (`coaches()`) give their opinion until the first one who gives a verdict: the perceived reputation = random(2500) + club reputation (`reputation()`) / 2 + training × 12.5 (`rdata::F64_12_5`, truncated); the two perceived abilities (`exe::match_man_judge_player_ability` with 2 and with 1) against reputation / 50 + 75 (verdict 2) and reputation / 100 + 50 (1). With a verdict: 7 assistant?, 8..0xb who (id and names), 0xc and 0xd the verdicts; otherwise −1. Delivered at the club's scope (`exe::news_send_by_scope`).

Returns the random score of how well the club suits the youth player: reputation against the player's reputation and ability, training facilities, human control and nation. \n The score of `club` for the young `player` (random(score), `exe::utils_random`): 5000 + reputation (`reputation()`) minus its distances to the player's current reputation (player record `player()`: `current_reputation()`) and to his potential and current ability × 50 (`potential_ability()`, `current_ability()`); with `potential_ability()` above random(20) + 100, the training facilities bonus (`training()`, 20 = guaranteed, otherwise random(`training()`) > random(20)); a club of an active competition (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`) with `potential_ability()` > 50: the human club state (`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE`) and the reputation against the squad (`squad`); the manager's work with young players (`manager()` → `non_player()`: `youngsters()`, `judging_potential()`) at a computer club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`) or the human's bonus; the same nation (`nation()` of the player and of the club) and the Welsh clubs (Swansea, Cardiff, Wrexham) and Scotland (`KEY_NATION_SCOTLAND`). Only the low 16 bits of the score count.

Rolls a recurring injury: when the record has none (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` = 0xff) and the injury type can recur (the 13-byte table at 0x9e7ae0), with 1 in 20 the record takes it (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` = the type, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0; otherwise nothing else happens); then, among the records with a recurring injury, the best score (random(0x65) − 5 × `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` − `injury_proneness()` of the player sheet; 100 without a player sheet; stops at 95): a player at a club with reputation above 4250, not human-run (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), with 1 in 3, gets a new injury 0x4e, 0x4f or 0x4d by the recurring type (`exe::injury_add_injury`); otherwise his mark is cleared (`physical_record::RECURRING_TYPE` = 0xff, `physical_record::RECURRENCE_GRADE` = 0). The plan is in `plan_recurring_injury`; the routine runs in Rust (in `PROLOGOS`, compared by `compare_roll_recurring_injury`).
